central_question: How can teams govern AI reviews and trace a finding without treating reported provenance as proof of correctness?
claims_and_limits: Enterprise, organization and repository controls have distinct authority and token support.
Attribution fields describe review effort when available and sources Copilot reported for a comment; they do not establish causal influence.
Balanced uses three reviewer models plus a combining model, with no independent accuracy benchmark in the announcement.

visual.shared_motif: Amber layered review table, provenance lens and human reviewer; inner image separates policy, reported context and human decision.
visual.status: Conceptual editorial visualization, not an exact GitHub interface or causal diagram.
